info.title: PromptLab local library contract candidate
info.description: Unconnected candidate with reviewed import, checkpoint restore and branch reconciliation. Pairing, complete domain activation and installed desktop support remain open. Folder recovery uses explicit verified head selection, bounded graph-pinned inspection and version 2 journal transactions with parent lists. Legacy journal bytes remain readable and unchanged. Older runtimes may not read version 2 descendants; rollback must preserve the full folder for recovery.

get.description: Requires read scope. Revision must remain current through preparation and on every page. Optional domain filter and decimal offset cursor must remain unchanged while paging a revision. Raw values, source binding, replica and paths are retained. Multiple copies and unresolved references are explicit. This preserved view does not activate a library or authorize migration. Unknown or duplicate query parameters reject. Response limit is 64 MiB; reduce page size on 413. No record truncation.

post.description: Review two verified branches against their common ancestor, retain both complete histories and require explicit concurrent-edit choices. Requires write scope. In a folder recovery view, the response also binds folderRecovery to the current head set; changed graphs require fresh review. Apply through POST /v1/library/commits with an idempotency key. A committed folder reconciliation consumes only its reviewed parent heads; other heads remain for review.

post.description: Requires write scope. Pin the current revision. Prompt choices remain governed by import/reconciliation and deletion evidence. Differing replicas or absent records require explicit per-group choices naming an occurrence or null for inactive. Unknown sources block commit. Apply through the normal commit route with an idempotency key. This read-view contract does not authorize native activation. Recovery views reject this operation with RECOVERY_ONLY.

get.description: Requires read scope and a pinned current revision. Returns exact selected values and source-qualified references, including missing/ambiguous targets; all unselected data remain available through preserved record reads. A later import, restore or reconciliation requires a new selection review. Unknown/duplicate query parameters reject. The response is bounded at 64 MiB without truncation.

get.summary: Inspect verified folder heads without activating one
get.description: Requires read scope. Available even when normal reads fail with DIVERGENT_HEADS. Returns at most 100 complete branch summaries per page. Pin every continuation to graphRevision; a changed head set fails with FOLDER_CHANGED. All ancestry must be present and preserve retained objects, operation receipts and checkpoints. No paths or credentials are returned.

get.description: Requires read scope. Complete objects, receipts, checkpoints and metadata are verified before response. The 64 MiB HTTP response bound returns 413 instead of truncating; larger libraries need the paginated object and backup routes. Optional branch selection permits recovery reads while normal reads are blocked.

LegacyOutbox.description: Historical declaration only. Preserve without replay; it lacks the complete reviewed command and integrity bindings required by version 2.

DurableOutbox.description: App-owned pending command. Strict transaction completion acknowledges local persistence only. Hash and receipt bindings are verified by the shared runtime before replay. Completed records are retained.

FolderBranch.name: X-Library-Branch
FolderBranch.description: Explicit verified folder transaction selected from folder-branches. This recovery view follows its unique causal descendant for operation readback. Competing descendants or a changed sibling set require a fresh inspection and review. Only reconciliation may mutate a recovery view. It never activates another library.
